mapper.insert:
insert into recommendation (user_id, dish_id, reason, score, health_goal, create_time) values
(#{item.userId}, #{item.dishId}, #{item.reason}, #{item.score}, #{item.healthGoal}, #{item.createTime})
mapper.select: select r.id, r.user_id, r.dish_id, r.reason, r.score, r.health_goal, r.create_time, d.name dishName, u.nickname from recommendation r left join dish d on r.dish_id = d.id left join user u on r.user_id = u.id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by r.score desc
select d.name name, count(*) value from recommendation r inner join dish d on r.dish_id = d.id group by r.dish_id, d.name order by value desc limit 10
